maya: quick ping — PR to normalize Authorization header parsing for REST client + streaming SDKs. https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/1284
maya: main change is fallback to `authorization` lowercase header when `Authorization` absent; fixes some proxy setups.
maya: code snippet in PR: ```js
// prefer standard header, fall back to lowercase proxies
const auth = headers['Authorization'] || headers['authorization'];
if (!auth) return next(new Error('missing auth'))
```
ci-bot: CI started for PR #1284 — running unit tests + integration matrix :gear:
tom: :eyes: I'll try to review in the next 30m
liam: small question — does this change affect toolcall header forwarding? In streaming we rely on preserving casing for some load balancers.
sophia: looks fine at a glance. Can we add a unit test to verify both `Authorization` and `authorization` cases?
maya: good call — added a test in the latest commit, see the test file in the PR (tests/headers/authorization.spec.ts)
tom: left a tiny comment about a null header guard, otherwise LGTM
liam: approve after null guard
maya: updated — pushed `fix/null-guard` branch, addressed Tom's comment (guard + test for undefined headers)
ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #1284 ✅
devops-bot: Merge queue added PR #1284 — target merge window: immediate (maintainer approval received)
maya: thanks all — merging now :rocket:
